Backend: 5/5 passed (1 skipped due to no seed data). critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~7500 lines – strongly consider splitting into routers/modules for maintainability.

DiscoverPage useEffect returns early (line 81 `return () => unsubscribe();`) inside the `if (user?.id)` branch – code after it that initializes daily-swipe-count / extra-swipes from localStorage is never executed when a user is present. This is a real bug: dailySwipeCount stays 0 in state until the user swipes, so the on-screen 'swipes left' counter is wrong on refresh. Move the localStorage init above the early return.

ChatPage.jsx line 650 uses msg.created_at but backend/message model may use `timestamp` (temp messages set `timestamp`). Consider unifying to avoid 'Invalid Date' in the timestamp label for the optimistic temp message.
Reactions endpoint doesn't verify the reacting user is a participant of the match – any authenticated caller with a valid message_id can react. Add participant check for security.
